title: Ada Twist, Scientist
overview: Pint-sized scientist Ada Twist and her two best friends are asking big questions — and working together to discover the truth about everything!

title: Ask the Storybots
overview: Based on the award-winning educational apps, the StoryBots are curious little creatures who live in the world beneath our screens and go on fun adventures to help answer kids' questions, like how night happens or why we need to brush our teeth.

title: Charlie's Colorforms City
overview: Charlie creates fun stories using different shapes, and he needs your help! Come along for kid-friendly adventures here, there — and everywhere.

title: Dew Drop Diaries
overview: From finding lost items to cleaning up messes, three fairies in training love looking after kids in their care as they work toward earning their wings.

title: Emily's Wonder Lab
overview: Science-loving host Emily Calandrelli makes STEAM fun with activities, demonstrations and at-home experiments that'll make you think — and blow your mind!

title: Hey Duggee
overview: Animated preschool series about a clubhouse that is run by a big dog called Duggee.

title: Izzy's Koala World
overview: Young koala caretaker Izzy Bee and her family rescue cuddly creatures in need and help them head back into the wild on Australia’s Magnetic Island.

title: Little Baby Bum: Music Time
overview: Come join the fun at the magical Music Time preschool, where every day is an adventure filled with kid-friendly songs — and lots of learning!

title: Not Quite Narwhal
overview: Curious little Kelp's been living his whole life as a narwhal... until he finds out he's actually a unicorn. Now he's got two worlds to explore!

title: Sesame Street
overview: On a special inner city street, the inhabitants—human and muppet—teach preschoolers basic educational and social concepts using comedy, cartoons, games, and songs.

title: Storm on Sesame Street
overview: In the Storm on Sesame Street special, Elmo and his friends work together to get ready for a big storm, learning how to be prepared, have courage, and calm their bodies and minds when things feel scary. After the storm passes, Sesame Street looks different, and everyone pitches in to help their neighbors rebuild their homes. With the help of the neighborhood, including celebrity guests Post Malone and Michelle Buteau, Elmo and Abby set out to make a difference, and discover that small acts of kindness, and support from friends, can make the biggest difference of all.

title: Super Monsters
overview: Preschool kids whose parents are the world's most famous monsters try to master their special powers while preparing for kindergarten.

title: Tayo the Little Bus
overview: Tayo the Little Bus is a South Korean computer-generated animated television series created by Educational Broadcasting System, Iconix Entertainment, Seoul and Hot Animation which is owned by HiT Entertainment. The Korean-dubbed series began airing on EBS in 2010 and the English-dubbed series aired on Disney Junior in 2012. The latter is also scheduled to air on Disney Channel and Cartoonito in 2013. The narrator of the UK series is Michael Angelis who also narrates the UK series of Thomas & Friends.

title: The Magic School Bus
overview: An eccentric schoolteacher takes her class on wondrous educational field trips with the help of a magical school bus.

title: The Magic School Bus Rides Again
overview: Ms. Frizzle's sister takes her class on a slew of wild science adventures in this update of the beloved animated show.

title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
overview: When something's wrong in the Rainbow Kingdom, bighearted guardian True and her best friend, Bartleby, are there to grant wishes and save the day.

title: StoryBots: Answer Time
overview: Got a question? The StoryBots have an answer! Join curious friends Beep, Boop, Bing, Bang and Bo on fun adventures to find facts for real kids like you.

title: The Casagrandes Movie
overview: On a birthday trip to Mexico, 12-year-old Ronnie Anne accidentally frees a demigod trapped in a mountain and needs her family's help to set things right.

title: Dead End: Paranormal Park
overview: Two teens and a talking pug team up to battle demons at a haunted theme park — and maybe even save the world from a supernatural apocalypse.

title: Orion and the Dark
overview: A boy with an active imagination faces his fears on an unforgettable journey through the night with his new friend: a giant, smiling creature named Dark.
